children: Motilal Oswal Securities has named ICICI Bank, State Bank of India, Kotak Mahindra Bank and AU Small Finance Bank as its top picks, expecting the banking sector to deliver a 15% earnings CAGR over FY26-28E, led by private banks.
In a note on Monday, October 5, the brokerage said, "Credit growth remained strong at 18.8% YoY; mid-sized private banks likely to lead."

Systemic credit growth remained healthy at 18.8% as of September 15, driven by "sustained retail demand and higher utilization levels by MSME borrowers", "healthy corporate borrowings with bond yields being elevated" and higher-than-expected FCNR(B) flows of $133 billion. Motilal Oswal expects FY27E credit growth to settle around 15.5%.

"Deposit growth surged to 17% YoY; CD ratio cools off to 80.8%," it said. Strong FCNR(B) inflows of $133 billion accounted for around 4.5% of system deposits, helping the CD ratio ease from a peak of 83.4% to 80.8%. "While FCNR(B) deposits have supported the deposit mobilization, banks continue to face challenges in mobilizing low-cost deposits," the brokerage said.
For large private banks, Motilal Oswal estimates NII growth of 8.9% YoY/2.5% QoQ for HDFC Bank, 16.8%/3.1% for ICICI Bank, 8.5%/1.9% for Axis Bank and 14%/5.1% for Kotak Mahindra Bank.

"NIMs are likely to dip 8-20bp owing to rapid business expansion with FCNR(B) inflows and the leverage provided against the same," it said. "However, the deployment of this surplus liquidity, and retirement of high-cost liabilities would drive steady earnings growth."
The brokerage expects private banks' PAT to grow 24% YoY/1.7% QoQ in 2QFY27 and earnings to post a 20% CAGR over FY26-28.
PSU banks, asset quality remain resilient
"PSU banks: NIMs to remain resilient; 2Q PAT to grow 27% YoY/19% QoQ," Motilal Oswal said. It expects PSU banks' NII to grow 10.8% YoY/1.6% QoQ and earnings to post an 11% CAGR over FY26-28.
"Asset quality outlook benign; credit cost to remain in control," it said, though it remains watchful of the uncertain macro environment and below-normal monsoon.
For its coverage universe, Motilal Oswal expects 2QFY27 PAT to grow 25.4% YoY/9.5% QoQ and earnings to deliver a 15% CAGR over FY26-28.

title: ICICI Bank, SBI, Kotak Bank: Why Motilal Oswal picked these banking stocks; check CAGR, target price and more
